sentences.en: Please don't let me hear any more of that story.
sentences.zh: 别让我再听那个故事了。

sentences.en: Every reporter sent his stories with the least possible delay.
sentences.zh: 每个记者都尽量尽快地提交他们的报道。

sentences.en: Well, I think it's time the real story was told.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为是时候讲出真相了。

senses.zh: 故事；小说；描述；新闻报道；来历；假话；层；一种测量单位（1 story 等于 3.3 米）
